facts: The surface station occupies the block between Carrefour de l'Europe, Putterie, Cantersteen and boulevard de l'Imperatrice.
The surface building has five levels plus a mezzanine responding to the slope toward boulevard de l'Imperatrice.
Facades are faced in white stone with a blue-stone base and crown and bronze window frames.
The main entrance at Putterie / boulevard de l'Imperatrice is concave; its ground-floor opening is carried by four columns under a canopy.
The upper main entrance elevation is organized as nine three-sided bow-window bays.
The station is a sober functional composition with classical and Art Deco reminiscences.
